en-US.description:
Five bright affirmations every morning, picked for what you want more of. Say them out loud, save the ones that land, and build a daily habit that keeps you on your own side.

SAY IT OUT LOUD
SayBright starts with your first affirmation in under a minute. Pick what you want more of, read it, say it, and feel the difference a kind sentence makes.

FIVE A DAY, FREE
Every day brings five fresh affirmations from the topics you chose, the same five your morning reminder points to. Swipe through them, save your favorites, and come back tomorrow for five more.

TEN CATEGORIES, 340 AFFIRMATIONS
Confidence, Gratitude, Morning Energy, Self Love, Career Growth, Relationships, Health and Body, Wealth and Abundance, Calm and Anxiety Relief, and Creativity. Confidence is fully open on the free plan, and every other category lets you read a preview.

HEAR IT IN YOUR OWN VOICE
Record any affirmation in your own voice and play it back whenever you need it. Hearing your own words is a simple way to make positive self talk stick.

WRITE YOUR OWN
Keep personal affirmations in My Affirmations, right next to the ones we wrote for you.

BUILD YOUR STREAK
Open SayBright each day to grow your streak, and celebrate milestones at 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180 and 365 days.

SHARE CARDS
Turn any affirmation into a beautiful quote card for Stories, iMessage or anywhere you want to spread some light.

HOME SCREEN AND LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
Keep an affirmation in view all day with widgets that refresh throughout the day.

DAILY REMINDERS
Pick a time and SayBright sends one gentle reminder a day, so your practice becomes a habit.

FREE TO START
The free plan includes five affirmations a day, the full Confidence category, previews of every other category, streaks, share cards, reminders and your own written affirmations.

SAYBRIGHT PREMIUM
Premium opens all 10 categories and every affirmation with no daily limit, home screen and lock screen widgets, recordings in your own voice, watermark free share cards and no ads.

Premium is offered as a monthly or a yearly subscription. Each plan starts with a 7 day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Prices are shown in the app before you subscribe.

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. If you start a free trial, payment is charged when the trial ends unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage and cancel your subscriptions in your App Store account settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Privacy Policy: https://graysmithlabs.com/apps/saybright-privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
en-US.promoText: New look, and now five free affirmations a day. Premium starts with a free week for eligible new subscribers: every category, no limits and no ads.
en-US.title: SayBright: Daily Affirmations
en-US.subtitle: Positive Thinking & Self Love
en-US.releaseNotes:
SayBright has a brand new look, from the icon to every screen.

Five free affirmations a day instead of one, and the whole Confidence category is now open to everyone. Every other category has a preview you can read before deciding on Premium.

A new start for first time users: pick what you want more of and say your first affirmation right away.

Fewer interruptions: no more welcome screen on every launch, and full screen ads are limited to one per visit and never before you finish your daily five.

Thank you for saying something kind to yourself today.

review.notes: No login is needed. To reach the paywall as a new user: complete onboarding (Get started, Continue, I said it, Continue, Not now on the reminder step) and the last onboarding step is the Premium screen; tap Not now to close it. In the app: open the Browse tab and tap any category with a lock (for example Career Growth), then tap the gold Open button under the preview, or open the Settings tab and tap SayBright Premium. Both plans start with a 7 day free trial for eligible new Apple IDs. Ads are AdMob; the tracking prompt appears after onboarding.
